      public String getDeathCause(String name)
      Provides the cause of death of the person with the given name.
      Specified by:
      getDeathCause in interface DeathNote
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the person whose death cause to return
      Returns:
      the death cause of the person with the given name. If the cause of death is not specified, the method will return "heart attack".
